zh: 长度至少为 2 的区间里，最大值旁边一定有另一个元素，而这个邻居不小于整个区间的最小值。
因此任何长区间的“最小值+最大值”都不超过某一对相邻元素之和，只需要考虑长度恰为 2 的区间。
遍历 i=0..n−2，计算 a[i]+a[i+1]，取最大值输出；数值可到 2×10⁹，注意使用 64 位整数。
en: In a subarray of length at least 2, the maximum element always has a neighbour inside it, and that neighbour is no smaller than the subarray's minimum.
So min plus max of any long subarray is at most the sum of some adjacent pair; only subarrays of length exactly 2 need to be considered.
Loop i = 0..n-2, compute a[i] + a[i+1] and print the largest value; the sum can reach 2 * 10^9, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

It is enough to enumerate every pair of adjacent elements and take the maximum of their sums.

## Why it is correct

Take any valid subarray and its maximum element M; M has at least one adjacent element x inside the subarray. Since x is no smaller than the subarray's minimum m, this adjacent pair has sum M + x >= M + m. Therefore no longer subarray is better than some subarray of length 2.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1) apart from the input.
